data_lag_audit.detail: 2026-10-30 is an official trading day; the market closed 0.7h ago and no bar has been published to this panel yet

headline: freeze is a false positive for revision: the only face that failed is the bar whose panel was still filling -- no settled bar moved
recommended_rule: A drift gate may only police SETTLED bars. The newest published bar is provisional until its panel date stops gaining symbols (coverage stable across consecutive runs); while it is provisional, a re-derivation mismatch is expected and must be reported, not frozen on -- and never bought with a history rewrite.
caveats: Point-in-time coverage at pricing time is not recorded anywhere, so 'the panel was still filling' is inferred from the panel's current shape (post-close arrivals) plus the timestamp of the run that priced the bar, not observed directly.
This audit reads the panel's date columns only; it does not re-run the engine, so it cannot attribute the 5.064e-06 to a named symbol.

0 removed 2026-10-2x rows in git diff over data/daily is evidence of no rewritten price, not proof: a symbol that arrived late is an addition, and an addition is exactly what this audit says moved the mark.
